g.text: $ python -m heat3d_gamefiles --help
usage: heat3d_gamefiles [-h]
{identify,list,extract,meshes,course,courses,cars,terrain,levels,level,ue-maps,ue-map,enfusion-…
Read level data out of shipped game archives.
positional arguments:
{identify,list,extract,meshes,course,courses,cars,terrain,levels,level,ue-maps,ue-map,enfusion-worlds,enfusion-world}
identify say what a file is
list list what is inside an archive
extract write one entry to disk
meshes list the meshes in a Unity container
course export the ground around a lap, working out the rest
courses export every course in a recorded lap library, one
file each
cars every car of an installed Forza at low detail, in one
file for the viewer
terrain cut a piece of Forza terrain out, by world coordinates
levels list the levels of an installed Frostbite game
level export a Frostbite level: its terrain backdrop and
placed meshes
ue-maps list the World Partition maps of an Unreal 5 game
ue-map export an Unreal 5 World Partition map: landscape,
HLOD structures, water
enfusion-worlds list the worlds of an installed Arma Reforger
enfusion-world export an Arma Reforger world: terrain, its colour,
the sea, building boxes
options:
-h, --help show this help message and exit
Encrypted archives need a key you already hold; this tool has none and
recovers none. What you point it at is subject to that game's own licence.
